Message from Aura: To get started, you mainly just need the right fit: - Clean the ear tips and earplug body before every use - Check that the ear tip is firmly attached - Your earplugs should sit flush—no sticking out - If your voice sounds louder inside your head, that’s a good sign you’ve got a solid seal - Your left and right ears may need different sizes If you’re considering Loop Dream Earplugs, replace the ear tips after 100 uses.
